summary: All seven non-null dimensions clear the threshold independently; the two iteration-1 remediations are confirmed correct — Hoelzel 2004 as `mechanism_review` (a peer-reviewed method-comparison study, not a regulatory body) and the prediabetes IFCC upper bound at 47 mmol/mol (the clinical convention: one unit below the 48 mmol/mol diabetes cut-point, not the raw rounded output of converting 6.4%). Conversion table values, ADAG equation outputs, and eAG figures all verified arithmetically within accepted rounding tolerances.
